pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [312, 881, 365, 1018] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Temporal_Reason: The pedestrian remains completely stationary across all 15 frames with no behavioral transitions from standing to walking, no preparatory movements, and no head turns toward traffic that would indicate crossing intention.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian will not cross the road because they remain completely stationary with no crossing preparation, are positioned away from the roadway, and show no awareness of or reaction to the steady-moving traffic around them.
